About

A kids-only program for the chance to build.

AfroBot is a kids-only youth robotics and AI program.

AfroBot is a program of Glappy Foundation, a Texas nonprofit corporation. Glappy Foundation is separate from Glappy Inc.

Children take part through a parent or guardian.

The work started in Cameroon in November 2022 and has run for about 4 years. A US pilot followed in McKinney, Texas.

Where the work stands

  1. Since 2022

    Cameroon programs began in November 2022.

  2. McKinney

    A 2024 pilot of about 30 students in Texas.

  3. 2027

    Dallas–Fort Worth scales the 2024 pilot to about 15 teams and about 90 students. Other US regions stay proposed.

  4. April 2028

    A Dallas championship is proposed, pending partner confirmation.

The record so far

About 5,000 children have been trained through our holiday programs in Cameroon.

About 3,200 pupils aged 8–15 are in EDUCARE School Bamenda's primary and secondary schools. The partnership has run since June 2023.

Holiday totals: AfroBot records, November 2026. EDUCARE school reach: signed partnership letter, November 2026.

Contact

Access for every child

Robotics and AI should not depend on a family’s income or zip code. Team fees stay low, and sponsors and donors cover the rest. Kits and mentors are provided through partner schools. The focus is communities with fewer STEM opportunities in the US and Africa, and girls and boys are equally welcome.
